CASE - GENERAL MEDICINE FINAL PRACTICAL EXAMINATION "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is a online E log book to discuss our patient’s de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian’s signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs .This E log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs in comment box is welcome.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E38 year old female Came to OPD with an Chief complient of : Poor stream of urine since 1 month.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Dysuria (painful urination) since 18 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Burning micturition since 13 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Pain in lower abdomen since 13 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of Present illness\u0026nbsp; :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month back , then she developed poor stream of urine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eshe developed pain during micturition since 18 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain in lower abdomen Spasmodic type of pain\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Enon radiating\u0026nbsp; with no aggrevating and relieving factors\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBurning micturition since 13 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient had H\/O urinary retention , poor stream of urine and burning micturition\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O fever, vomitings,nausea,increased frequency,loose stools .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMENSTRUAL HISTORY\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECycle - 5\/30 days and regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe had history of 2 abortions\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1st abortion at age of 19Years old\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2nd abortion at age of
